Anticipation builds for the upcoming bond auction, with many investors eyeing potential attractive buy opportunities due to the current yield levels.

EBITDA rose 29.6% to Rs 1,054 crore, with margins improving to 18.2%. The retailer expanded its footprint across Westside, Zudio and other lifestyle concepts.
